skill.name: performance-analyzer
skill.description: Analyze influencer campaign performance across platforms, creators, content formats, engagement quality, and conversion attribution using provided campaign data.
skill.summary: Builds influencer campaign scorecards, rankings, attribution summaries, and prioritized learnings from supplied performance data.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most findings are false positives caused by Markdown links, code fences, placeholders, and homepage metadata. One medium issue remains: the skill instructs the agent to run an optional Python YouTube connector from CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, which is legitimate but still external command execution. No prompt injection, data-exfiltration intent, or malicious override text was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Optional connector command in skill instructions
remediation.suggestion: State that command execution requires user confirmation, restrict it to a trusted plugin root, and document expected arguments.

remediation.issue: YouTube API key handling is only briefly described
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that the skill should never print, store, or expose YOUTUBE_API_KEY and should use user-managed credentials only.

remediation.issue: Relative documentation links resemble traversal patterns
remediation.suggestion: Keep links as documentation references and avoid phrasing that implies arbitrary filesystem reads outside the skill directory.

content.value_statement: Influencer results are hard to compare across creators, platforms, and content formats. This skill turns supplied metrics into scorecards, rankings, attribution summaries, and next-campaign actions.
actual_capabilities: Scores reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, conversions, and revenue against targets and benchmarks.
Ranks platforms, creators, and content formats with reasons for top and bottom performance.
Assesses engagement quality, comment sentiment, and purchase intent signals from supplied data.
Breaks conversions into promo code, UTM, direct, and estimated attribution methods.
Produces ranked learnings, roster recommendations, and future campaign optimization priorities.
limitations: Results depend on the accuracy and completeness of the campaign data supplied by the user.
It does not perform full dollar-level return math; use the ROI calculator skill for that step.
Winner calls need enough sample size and benchmark context to avoid weak conclusions.
Optional YouTube measurement requires a local connector and a user-managed YouTube API key.

use_cases.title: Review a completed creator campaign
use_cases.description: Turn platform exports, creator reports, and sales data into a clear post-campaign performance readout.

use_cases.title: Compare creators for renewal decisions
use_cases.description: Rank creators by reach, engagement quality, conversions, and content effectiveness before renewing contracts.

use_cases.title: Find channel and content learnings
use_cases.description: Identify which platforms, formats, hooks, and messages should guide the next campaign plan.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze one campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze our [campaign name] influencer campaign for [date range]. I will provide platform metrics, creator reports, traffic, conversions, and promo code data.

prompt_templates.title: Compare campaign creators
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these creators from [campaign name]: [handles]. Rank them by reach, engagement quality, conversions, content strength, and renewal recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Find winning content patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the content performance for [campaign name]. Identify top formats, themes, hooks, platform differences, and the patterns we should repeat.

prompt_templates.title: Build an attribution readout
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a full performance readout for [campaign name]. Include target comparisons, benchmark gaps, platform rankings, creator rankings, attribution by method, and top five learnings.

output_examples.input: Summer skincare campaign with ten creators, platform exports, traffic, and promo code sales.
output_examples.output: A campaign scorecard showing reach above target, conversions below target, top creators, weaker formats, and renewal recommendations.

output_examples.input: Creator comparison for five TikTok and Instagram partners after a launch week.
output_examples.output: A ranked creator list with engagement quality notes, conversion contribution, content anatomy, and renew, expand, or replace guidance.

output_examples.input: Post-level metrics across Reels, Stories, TikTok videos, and YouTube videos.
output_examples.output: A content pattern summary naming winning hooks, strongest formats, platform-specific gaps, and next campaign tests.

best_practices: Provide targets, benchmarks, and raw metric totals before asking for winner or renewal calls.
Separate measured platform data from creator-supplied reports and note any timing differences.
Use the resulting learnings as inputs for ROI calculation and the next campaign plan.
anti_patterns: Do not treat small samples as proof that one creator or format is a true winner.
Do not mix revenue attribution methods without labeling promo code, UTM, direct, and estimated results.
Do not ask this skill to replace the dedicated ROI calculator for detailed return math.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide campaign dates, creators, platforms, reach, views, engagement, clicks, conversions, sales, promo codes, targets, and benchmarks when available.

faq.question: Can it compare influencers against each other?
faq.answer: Yes. It ranks creators and explains performance differences using supplied reach, engagement, conversion, and content data.

faq.question: Does it calculate final ROI?
faq.answer: No. It can organize performance inputs, but detailed dollar-level ROI should be handled by the ROI calculator skill.

faq.question: Can it analyze comment sentiment?
faq.answer: Yes. It can summarize comment sentiment and purchase intent when comments or representative samples are provided.

faq.question: Does it require live platform access?
faq.answer: No. It works with pasted exports and reports. Optional YouTube measurement can use a local connector when configured.

faq.question: How should I use the final recommendations?
faq.answer: Use them to renew strong creators, improve weak formats, adjust platform mix, and define tests for the next campaign.
